data.name: Afqah
data.gender_notes: Afqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Afqah means 'seeker', 'the one who yearns for knowledge'. It is derived from the Arabic root verb 'afqaha' which means 'to seek, to strive, to ask'. The name holds a special significance in Islamic culture as it reflects the spirit of inquiry and learning that is encouraged in the religion. The name Afqah carries the meaning “Seeking, yearning for knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afqah usually hope their child will grow to embody seeking, yearning for knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May this name inspire a deep sense of curiosity and a thirst for knowledge.
data.etymology: Afqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeking, yearning for knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afqah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Afqah
in_english.meaning: One who has knowledge of the religion
in_english.long_meaning: The name Afqah is derived from the Arabic root 'F-Q-H', which means to understand or comprehend. It refers to someone who possesses knowledge of the religion, particularly Islamic law and jurisprudence. This name holds significant spiritual and cultural value in Islamic tradition, symbolizing wisdom, knowledge, and piety. Historically, individuals with this name have been respected for their understanding and interpretation of Islamic teachings.

data.cultural_impact: The name Afqah is a powerful reminder of the importance of knowledge and learning in Islamic culture. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encouraged his followers to seek knowledge from all sources and marveled at the ideas that their observations would bring. The name Afqah honors this tradition of intellectual curiosity and shapes the identity of those who bear it as individuals who value knowledge and wisdom. In today's world, with the vast amount of information readily available, the name Afqah remains relevant as a reminder to continue the pursuit of knowledge and to edify oneself.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Afqah holds deep significance as it connects the individual to the essence of the Islamic faith. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim," and the name Afqah embodies this commandment. Seeking knowledge is a means of drawing closer to Allah, as it is a way of understanding the divine wisdom and guidance contained in the Quran and Hadith. By embracing the name Afqah, one embraces the spiritual journey of a lifelong learner, striving to deepen their understanding of God and His creation. Furthermore, the spiritual significance of the name extends beyond the individual, as the pursuit of knowledge and dissemination of knowledge is an act of worship that benefits the ummah as a whole.
